glossary.definition: (A) "Poison prevention and treatment center" means an entity designated as a poison prevention and treatment center by the director of health under section 3701.20 of the Revised Code.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 3701.19 to 3701.201 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (B) "Harm" means injury, death, or loss to person or property.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 3701.19 to 3701.201 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (C) "Tort action" means a civil action for damages for injury, death, or loss to person or property. "Tort action" includes a product liability claim that is subject to sections 2307.71 to 2307.80 of the Revised Code, but does not include a civil action for a breach of contract or another agreement between persons.
